lesson: LITERAL CARD COPY (the full contract with every ruling is in this worktree at plans/exploration/askfloor-1-t5a-taskplan.md — read its "Owner rulings" and "Orchestrator rulings" sections; the delegated brief carries only the acceptance criteria). Alternative slot, exactly one, precedence family > trust growth > folder: FAMILY = the existing CARDSIMPLE-1 family button and its existing line, unchanged ("Allow all `<family>` commands"; promotion hint suppressed; it is a durable-policy row, not memory). TRUST GROWTH = button "Allow all <label> actions", line "Allow all <label> actions will remember: every <label> action, anywhere." where <label> is the tool's human label, else the name the card already shows for the tool, else the alternative is NOT offered (never the canonical id). FOLDER = button "Allow only in this folder", line "Allow only in this folder will remember: only in <folder>." Main buttons in order: "Allow" (remembered, default) / the alternative / "Just this once" / "No". Pre-tap block: "Allow will remember: <scope noun>" (writes: "writing to <path> — any future content, no more asking for this file"), then the alternative's line when present, ending with "No will remember: this exact action." Post-tap: "Remembered: <scope>. Change it any time with /permissions." (writes: "Remembered: writes to <path> (any content). Change it any time with /permissions."; remembered No: "I'll keep saying no to this exact action. Change it with /permissions."; Just this once: today's receipt). Scope nouns: "this exact action" / "this kind of action, anywhere" / "only in <folder>". Destructive: three buttons, no alternative, pre-tap "Allow will remember: this exact command only — nothing broader. No will remember: this exact command." Protected: reason line "<path> is protected, so I always ask.", buttons "Allow once" / "No" only. Batch: "Allow all and Deny all are once-only. Tap Review each to decide one at a time — those cards can remember." No rails-bump line anywhere.
